_what: Words a person sends over and over (src/snippets.mjs): a reply they give often, an introduction, a sign-off. A snippet is a saved piece of writing with a title, its words and optional tags; `{name}` in its words is a named blank filled when it is used. Saving, finding and removing a snippet are the store's job (workflow:keep-the-persons-snippets), whose rules are its own values; the record type, the blank's pattern and the words this tool shows are rows here.
